scenes.intent: stop the scroll with a question to a night-time viewer
scenes.action: "Still awake?" decodes out of orange signal noise above a flat orange trace that is already searching

scenes.intent: make it personal and a little funny
scenes.action: "Good." slams in on the kick; "So are we." answers in italic

transition.carrier: the trace starts to carry a waveform

scenes.intent: say what the show is about
scenes.action: three lines decode one by one while the waveform grows; midnight lands in orange
scenes.text: Some conversations / only come through / after midnight.

transition.carrier: the waveform surges and collapses into the title underline

scenes.action: LATE SIGNALS lands with a push-through; the trace becomes its underline and pulses on the beat; tagline answers
scenes.text: LATE SIGNALS / A podcast. Tune in.

concept: a faint orange signal in the dark finds the viewer at night, gets stronger line by line, and locks into the show's name: the late hours are where the good talk is
recurring_element: one orange signal line (an oscilloscope trace) that is flat, pulses, carries every transition and finally becomes the underline of the title

banned.avoid: holds over 0.5 s where nothing changes
banned.instead: a reading hold keeps the text still and moves what surrounds it
every scene grows out of the previous one through the recurring element
light only where something on screen emits it
motion starts from or ends in an element already on screen
overshoot only on the hero landing
text only when it says something

banned.avoid: anything that looks like a template
banned.instead: if a default appears, replace it with a decision

audience: night-time scrollers in bed or on a late commute who like long, honest conversations
